'''[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Kestal''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ag "Aggressor" Starfighter/Legends|TIE/AG Aggressor starfighter]] [[TIE pilot|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
At one point, Kestal conducted an operation on an arid planet with red cliffs, and proceeded to fly around and underneath them.<ref name="XWM" />

==Personality and traits==
Kestal was a very skilled pilot, which helped her stand out over other elite pilots, and allowed her to be trained to fly the expensive, multi-role TIE Aggressor starfighter. She was one of the most aggressive and talented Aggressor pilots of the Imperial Navy.<ref name="FFG.com" />
